title: Ebner effect: high voltage on crops

tellings.quote: For example, there was something called the Ebner effect, I believe in the 1990s.

plain: An engineer named Dave Rossi tells podcast host Jesse Michels about something he calls the Ebner effect, which he believes dates from the 1990s in Europe. As he describes it, it involved putting high voltage on crops and seeing what happened to them. He brings it up as an example of electricity shaping living things in ways that ordinary science has overlooked.
